messages.text: No, thanks—I don’t need a person. Does cancelling with the card button before payout stop the refund?

Yes. Until a proposal is paid, you can cancel it with the button on its card, and a cancelled request is not paid (refund-policy/v2/approval). All three of your requests for the ivory scarf were cancelled that way, so no refund is under way for it.

The scarf is still recorded as received back and not yet refunded. Your refund deadline for this order is 2026-12-01 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). Ask me for a new proposal before then if you still want the refund. A request made after the deadline would be refused as late.
